column2: req_desc

Keyboard pick-up, drop and cancel
A person who may move a post picks it up with Space, moves it with the arrow keys, drops it with Space or cancels with Escape, with focus kept on the frame and each step announced with the move lines from Feedback states.

Arrow targets follow the layout
In columns layout ArrowUp and ArrowDown change the position within a section and ArrowLeft and ArrowRight change section, rows layout swaps the two pairs, and edges and clamping behave as stated in Interactions.

Moves insert and close gaps
A saved move inserts the post at its target position and renumbers both sections exactly as in the worked examples in Business rules, and the order persists in `GET /api/boards/<id>/posts` and after reload.

Moves reach every open screen
Every other open screen of the board shows a saved move in the same order as the API within the live band, without reload.

Mouse drag reorder
Pressing on a frame and moving at least 8 pixels starts a drag, and dropping on a frame or on a section's empty space places the post as stated in Interactions and announces the drop line.

Touch long-press drag
On a touch screen a 500 millisecond long press on a frame the person may move starts the same drag, and lifting the finger drops it.

Settle motion
After a drop the frame settles into its slot and its neighbours slide to theirs in 150 to 300 milliseconds, and under reduced motion they jump with no animation.

Section counts stay exact
Each section's `data-count` always equals the published posts stored for that section on every open screen, within the live band, after moves, new posts, approvals and deletions.

Sort locks order within a section
Under any sort but By hand a post can change section but not position within one, and blocked attempts and any move while grouped by author leave the post in place and announce the published line.

Add post by keyboard and tap
A contributor opens Add post, fills it by keyboard or by tap and submits with Ctrl+Enter or Post, and focus lands on the new frame.

Simultaneous posts share one order
Posts submitted at the same moment land in the server's commit order on every open screen, matching the API, and every other open screen announces each one with the new-post line.

Post title and text limits
The Title counter and the server enforce the published title and text limits with the same messages, as stated in Business rules and Feedback states.

Likes and votes
Like and Vote buttons in the loupe toggle by keyboard or click with `aria-pressed`, one like and one vote per person, and the score is up votes minus down votes.

Reaction counts equal stored rows
Like counts, vote scores and comment counts on every frame and in the API equal the stored rows, including simultaneous reactions by one person from two tabs, and change live on other screens.

Signed-out readers cannot react
A signed-out stranger on a public board sees the counts but no Like, Vote, comment box or Add post control, and their reaction requests answer 401.

Most liked re-sorts live
Under Most liked a new like re-sorts the post on every open screen within the live band.

Loupe lift
Enter, click or tap on a frame opens the Loupe lift on that same element with focus on its heading, and Escape or a second tap closes it and returns focus to the frame.

Loupe lift motion
The loupe grows to its open size in 200 to 360 milliseconds while its neighbours dim, and under reduced motion it opens and closes instantly with no reflow animation or dimming fade.

Loupe follows a live move
When someone else moves the post in an open loupe, the loupe stays open on the post at its new place and announces the loupe-move line.

Live comments
A comment sent with Enter appears in every open loupe of that post and raises `data-comments` on every screen within the live band, with the box emptied and focused.

Comment limits
Comments of 1 to 500 characters are accepted, and empty or longer ones show the published message in the form and answer 422 on the server.

Names without emails
Comments, posts, the CSV, pushes and every response show people by display name only, never by email, except the caller's own account and the owner-only member and invite responses listed in Business rules.

Held posts wait for approval
With approval on, a contributor's new post is held and shown with the held-post note only to its author in Waiting for approval and to moderators and the owner in Approvals, until it is approved or rejected.

Held posts stay private
A held or rejected post answers 404 by id to everyone it is hidden from and never appears in their screens, the embed, share pages, the slideshow or the CSV.

Approvals by keyboard
A moderator approves or rejects each held post with its buttons by keyboard, focus moves to the next held post or the Approvals heading, the post is published live last in its section or removed, and the author hears the approved or rejected line.

Approval push
Holding a post publishes exactly one ntfy message naming only the board and the post title, posts that are not held send none, and a push ntfy did not accept shows `Push pending` in Approvals alongside the push banner.

Role-restricted actions refused
Requests a role may not send, such as approve, reject, role, member, settings, export, comment or moving and deleting others' posts, answer 403 on the server, as qualified in Business rules.

Controls follow role
Each role sees exactly its controls listed in Public screens and controls, and a control a role may not use is absent from the page, never disabled.

Invite by email
The owner invites by email from Members, the invite mail arrives in Mailpit with the published subject and link, and accepting it joins the invitee with the invited role, as qualified in Business rules.

Sign-up with an emailed code
A new person signs up, confirms the 6-digit code mailed to them and can then sign in, while wrong, expired or unconfirmed attempts show the published messages.

Role changes apply live
A role change or removal changes that member's open board controls within the live band without reload, announces the role line or shows the not-found screen, and their next write answers by the error order.

Mail outage
When mail cannot be sent, sign-up creates no account and an invite stores nothing, each answering 503 and showing its published alert.

Private boards look absent
A private board, an unknown id and everything else a caller cannot open answer the same 404 and the same not-found screen, while a locked password board answers `password_required` with the password screen, as stated in Business rules.

Password boards
A password board asks non-members for its password, a wrong one answers 404 with the published alert, and a right one opens the board for the rest of the browser session or until the owner changes the password.

Share links
A Can view link opens the board read-only and a Can contribute link joins a signed-in person as a contributor, after the link's password unlock on a password board, as stated in Business rules.

Revocation takes effect at once
Rotating a link or making the board private makes old links answer 404, and changing the password makes old unlocks answer `password_required`, on the next request, and open screens that relied on them turn into the not-found screen or the password screen within the live band.

Phone upload sheet
On a 375 by 812 phone, Add post opens as a bottom sheet that slides up in 200 to 360 milliseconds (instantly under reduced motion), a file is attached by tap, and the post appears with its image after the upload announcement.

Accepted files and size cap
Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, PDF and plain UTF-8 text files of at most `UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES` bytes are accepted, judged by content, and others are refused with the published alerts and nothing stored.

Attached only after storage confirms
A post with a file is created and shown only after MinIO confirms its object under the published key.

Guarded attachment URLs
Attachments are served only through the app to callers who can open the post, images inline and other files as downloads, and every other caller gets the same 404 as for an unknown id.

Storage outage
When storage is down, a post with a file answers 503 with the published alert and keeps the typed title and text, posts without a file still work, and the board shows the storage banner.

Read-only embed
The embed of a public board with link access on shows its published posts with no write control, frames reachable by Tab, Enter opening a read-only loupe, and stacked sections with no sideways scroll at 375 pixels wide.

Embed stays live and published-only
The embed shows new published posts within the live band, never shows held or rejected posts, and answers 404 for private boards and boards with link access off.

Deleted means gone
A deleted post or board vanishes from every open screen, the embed, the slideshow and the CSV within the live band, its MinIO objects are removed, and its URLs answer 404.

Make a board
A signed-in person makes a board from the dashboard with a title and sections, it is listed under Your boards after reload, and the new board shows the empty-board line.

Board view toolbar
The owner sets layout, sort and grouping from the Board view toolbar by keyboard, the choice is saved, and every open screen re-arranges within the live band as stated in Business rules.

CSV export
Owners and moderators download the board's published posts as CSV with the exact header, displayed order and display names, and no held post, rejected post or email.

CSV formula neutralisation
Any CSV field starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return is prefixed with an apostrophe.

Slideshow
Present opens the slideshow over the published posts in displayed order, the published keys and buttons step through them with the position text, and Escape returns focus to Present.

Slideshow transition
Slides move out to the left and in from the right in 250 to 450 milliseconds, reversed going back, a swipe left goes next on touch, and reduced motion swaps instantly.

Slideshow stays live
A post published or deleted during a slideshow updates its count within the live band, and a deleted current post gives way to the next one.

Lost move announced
When two people move the same post at once, the loser's frame goes to the winner's place and the lost-move line is announced on the loser's screen.

One winner per post version
Of simultaneous moves carrying the same version exactly one answers 200 and the others 409 with the published conflict body, and every screen ends in the winner's order.

Post deleted while held
If a post is deleted while someone holds it mid-move, their move ends, the frame disappears and the deleted line is announced.

Run manifest and health
`/app/run.json` installs, builds and serves the app on port 4173, and `GET /api/health` answers 200 with the published status body.

Grading fixture
`POST /api/grading/fixture` with the right key creates the published users, boards and posts and returns their ids and sessions, and answers 404 otherwise.

One error order
Every API error follows the one precedence and body shape stated in Business rules.

Server boundary
The server is same-origin only, enforces the request size limits and never serves source files, credentials or paths outside its built assets.

Responsive sheet
Dashboard, board, slideshow and embed fit 375 by 812, 768 by 1024 and 1280 by 800 with the published sections per row and no sideways scroll.

Accessible to AA
Dashboard, board, slideshow and embed pass WCAG 2.2 AA automated checks, with every control at least 44 pixels to tap and Tab order following the sheet.

Contact-sheet look
Every screen reads as a dense contact sheet of small fixed-height frames on a sand ground in Work Sans at two sizes, with square corners, no shadows and moss-green actions.

Landing strip
The signed-out landing shows the near-black field with its four corner labels and the lit strip of demo frames described in Visual design.

Credentials from the environment
Every service URL and credential is read from the published environment variables at start and is never hard-coded or sent to the browser.
`/app/run.json` exists with string `install`, `build` and `serve` and `"_schema":"run-manifest-v1"`, and running those three commands in order starts the app.
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at `/app` lists every shipped package (the production dependency tree from `npm ls --omit=dev --all --json`), Work Sans and Lucide, each with its licence.
Every shipped package and asset is under MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, 0BSD or, for fonts, OFL-1.1.
The app uses only Postgres, MinIO, SMTP and ntfy as services. There is no other datastore, cache, queue or realtime process.
Pages load no asset from another origin. Work Sans is bundled and no CDN is used.
The seeded service configuration (the provided compose files and their credentials) is left unchanged.
`package-lock.json` is committed, and `install` uses it.
